description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_OEE" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/oee">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineData" name="Machine data"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OEEAlert" name="OEE below threshold alert"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_OEE">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OEE" name="OEE Process" processRef="Process_OEE"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Machine" name="Machine"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Engineer" name="Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineData" name="Machine data" messageRef="Message_MachineData" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Participant_Machine"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OEEAlert" name="OEE alert" messageRef="Message_OEEAlert" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Participant_Engineer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected" sourceRef="Participant_Machine" targetRef="StartEvent_Disconnected"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OEE" name="OEE" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Begin" name="Start measuring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Loop_Merge" name="Measuring cycle">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Continue</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RestartLoop</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCollect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectData" name="Collect machine data">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCollect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToCalculate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate OEE">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToCalculate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="OEE below threshold?" default="Flow_Continue">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Continue</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine" messageRef="Message_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToEmail</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer" messageRef="Message_OEEAlert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToEmail</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToRestartWait</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToRestartWait</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RestartLoop</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Restarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="SubProcess_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disconnected</bpmn:outgoing>
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Disconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StopProcess" name="Stop process">
        <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disconnected</bpmn:incoming>
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TerminateEventDefinition_Stop"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_StopProcess"/>
    </bpmn:subProcess>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Begin" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCollect" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToCalculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToThreshold" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThreshold" name="OEE below threshold" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_StopMachine">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${oee < oeeThreshold}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Continue" name="OEE acceptable" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToEmail" sourceRef="Task_StopMachine" targetRef="Task_SendEmail"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToRestartWait" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RestartLoop" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" id="Diagram_OEE"/>
</bpmn:definitions>
